enemies.name: Existing ranged enemy
enemies.counter: Break line of sight, parry or close during recovery.

enemies.name: Chain duelist
enemies.counter: Bait a long sweep, move outside its reach, punish the recovery.
enemies.implementation: Proposed telegraph 0.8 s, sweep reach 180 px, recovery 0.9 s; never turn freely after commitment.

enemies.name: Iron guard
enemies.counter: Flank the shield or bait a thrust and punish its exposed recovery.
enemies.implementation: Proposed frontal 120-degree guard, 0.9 s thrust cue, 1.0 s recovery; damage/interrupt rules need playtesting.

enemies.name: Thorn lantern
enemies.counter: Wait out or route around a clearly marked expanding hazard; strike during contraction.
enemies.implementation: Proposed 120 px zone, 1.0 s warning, 1.5 s active, 1.0 s recovery; never seal every viable route.

enemies.name: Bell warden
enemies.counter: Interrupt the windup or leave the marked ring before the delayed pulse.
enemies.implementation: Proposed 220 px pulse, 1.2 s cue, 1.0 s recovery; visual cue accompanies sound; no forced audio reliance.
